metadata.case_name: WONG BIK CHUEN v. HUA MIN TOURISM AUTOMOBILE TRANSPORT CO LTD

injuries.description: lower lip trauma with a wound of 3 x 2 cm;
source: lower lip trauma with a wound of 3 x 2 cm;
injuries.icd_description: Laceration without foreign body of head

injuries.description: dislocation of two lower central incisors (teeth No. 31 and 41);
source: dislocation of two lower central incisors (teeth No. 31 and 41);
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injury of periodontal tissues

injuries.description: subluxation with grade II mobility of two lower lateral incisors, (teeth Nos. 32 and 42).
source: subluxation with grade II mobility of two lower lateral incisors, (teeth Nos. 32 and 42).

manifestations.description: lower front incisors became loose immediately after the accident
pain and discomfort of teeth and gum
condition had affected his speech / he could not speak properly
a few months of discomfort and pain after the accident

treatments_received.treatment: debridement of wound; reduction of displaced and subluxed teeth under local anaesthetics and fixation by legation of wires
source: He received treatments, including debridement of wound, reduction of displaced and subluxed teeth under local anaesthetics and fixation by legation of wires.
treatments_received.vmis_procedure: Any kind of dental surgery due to injury caused by an Accident

treatments_received.treatment: root canal treatments of the four affected teeth
source: On 8 March 2008, he attended the Xiamen Hong Yun Oral Clinic 廈門鴻運陳聰口腔診所 operated by Dr Chan Chung. He had root canal treatments of the four affected teeth to relieve his pain and infection.

treatments_received.treatment: stabilisation of lower incisors with wire braces and brackets
source: His lower incisors were stabilised with wire braces and brackets as part of the treatment received.

treatments_future.treatment: conservative endodontic treatment (first plan) for displaced lower incisors (cost stated $74,000)
source: Dr Yung prescribed two plans of treatment. The first plan is a conservative treatment for Mr Wong’s displaced lower incisors by endodontic treatment which Dr Yung considered has only a 50 per cent chance of survival of Mr Wong’s lower central incisors.
The cost of the former treatment is $74,000;

treatments_future.treatment: teeth implant to replace the poor prognostic lower incisors (cost stated $119,000)
source: The second plan is to perform a teeth implant treatment to replace the poor prognostic lower incisors.
I will allow the award of the more expensive treatment of teeth implant ... Therefore, I assess the award at $119,000.
treatments_future.vmis_procedure: Any kind of dental surgery due to injury caused by an Accident

losses.description: Pain, suffering and loss of amenities arising from injury to mouth and teeth including bleeding, pain, infection, affected speech and several months of discomfort.
